summary: Structured 3K workout focusing on aerobic endurance, threshold.
riskReason: Structured pacing ensures safe muscular adaptation. Maintain proper hydration and dynamic warmup.

warmup.name: Dynamic Warmup
warmup.description: Easy jogging at RPE 3-4 followed by dynamic drills and light progressive strides.
notes: Begin very easy
Focus on high-cadence strides
Prepare joints and cardiovascular system

mainSet.name: 3K INTERVAL Interval Segment
mainSet.description: Run repetitions of 3000m at target 3K Race Pace / Aerobic Power intensity.
notes: Maintain consistent pacing throughout all 8 repeats.
Focus on clean running form and loose shoulders.
Use the 150s recovery to lower heart rate curves.

cooldown.name: Recovery Cooldown
cooldown.description: Light recovery jog followed by static stretching and mobility reset.
notes: Bring heart rate down completely
Perform dynamic stretches
Rehydrate immediately

easier.description: Reduce interval volume by running 6 repetitions.

mainSet.name: 3K INTERVAL Interval Segment
mainSet.description: Easier version: reduced volume to 6 reps.
notes: Maintain consistent pacing throughout all 8 repeats.
Focus on clean running form and loose shoulders.
Use the 150s recovery to lower heart rate curves.

harder.description: Increase interval volume by running 10 repetitions.

mainSet.name: 3K INTERVAL Interval Segment
mainSet.description: Harder version: increased volume to 10 reps.
notes: Maintain consistent pacing throughout all 8 repeats.
Focus on clean running form and loose shoulders.
Use the 150s recovery to lower heart rate curves.

coachingNotes: Stimulate maximum aerobic power (VO2-style) with progressive longer intervals.
Stay highly focused during the middle portion of the repeat where fatigue sets in.
Active recovery jogs must be steady to maintain elevated heart rate curves.
commonMistakes: Running too fast on recovery intervals, leading to premature workout fatigue.
Tensing the shoulders and neck during hard intervals, restricting breathing.
Neglecting proper dynamic warmup drills before starting high-velocity reps.
safetyNotes: Stay fully hydrated and check heart rate responses on hot or humid training days.
Halt execution immediately if experiencing any sharp joint or muscular pain.
Choose a flat, well-lit surface with clean traction for speed work.
